title: Angular Interpolation in Sparse-View Low-Dose CT Reconstruction: Placement Effects and Data-Consistency Step-Size Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.34508v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dual-domain networks combine projection and image processing for sparse-view low-dose computed tomography (CT). We quantify the contribution of angular interpolation before learning and distinguish its roles in sinogram initialisation and the image residual base. On synthetic parallel-beam data, parameter-free interpolation reduces noise-free missing-view mean absolute error by 99.7% relative to zero filling at 60 views. Full-view filtered back-projection (FBP) of the jointly learned completed sinogram adds 1.27 dB of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) over interpolated FBP. In a data-consistency dual-domain network (DC-DuNet), a 2x2 configuration ablation controls branch width, depth and training schedule while varying these placements and their associated input channels. After 20 epochs, the PSNR contrasts are +1.98 dB for sinogram initialisation and -2.16 dB for the interpolated image base; the image-base ranking also reverses during

translated_title: 稀疏视角低剂量CT重建中的角度插值：放置位置效应与数据一致性步长缩放
translated_abstract: 双域网络结合投影域和图像域处理来应对稀疏视角低剂量计算机断层扫描（CT）重建。我们量化了学习之前角度插值的贡献，并区分了其在正弦图初始化和图像残差基底中的不同作用。在合成平行束数据上，在60个视角条件下，无参数插值相对于零填充将无噪声缺失视角的平均绝对误差降低了99.7%。对联合学习完成补全的正弦图进行全视角滤波反投影（FBP），相比插值后FBP提升了1.27 dB的峰值信噪比（PSNR）。在数据一致性双域网络（DC-DuNet）中，通过2×2配置消融实验在控制分支宽度、深度和训练计划的同时，改变这些放置位置及其相关输入通道。在20个训练周期后，正弦图初始化带来+1.98 dB的PSNR对比增益，而插值图像基底则带来-2.16 dB的对比；图像基底的排序在训练过程中还发生了逆转……
tldr: 本文量化了角度插值在稀疏视角低剂量CT双域重建网络中的放置位置效应，发现用于正弦图初始化可带来显著增益（+1.98 dB PSNR），而作为插值图像基底反而产生负效应（-2.16 dB）。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the placement effects of angular interpolation in dual-domain sparse-view low-dose CT reconstruction, showing that interpolation for sinogram initialisation yields a +1.98 dB PSNR gain while its use as an interpolated image base leads to a -2.16 dB contrast.
